Officer's narrative
Officers were dispatched to a low-speed head-on collision in Katy, Texas, where Driver 1 and Driver 2 were involved
in a collision between two passenger vehicles traveling in opposite directions. Driver 1 was the operator of the first
vehicle and is listed as the named insured on the applicable policy. Driver 1 reported pain in the left knee and stated
that the front of the vehicle struck Driver 2's vehicle. The reported knee injury is consistent with the type and force of
the ipmact observed at the scene. Officers examined the damage to both vehicles, which corresponds with the
described collision. Photographs taken at the scene confirm several details of the account, though no independent
witnesses were identified. Officers confirmed through the scene and statements from others present that Passenger
was seated in Driver 1's vehicle at the time of the collision. Based on available records and inspection, no prior
damage to the vehicle was found. Further follow-up is pending.
